blocks.text:
Version-ledger discipline for markdown knowledge artifacts (ADRs, design docs,
PRDs — never source code). Use after creating or substantially revising a
markdown document in a repo containing proofpress.py.

1. History but no ledger entries? `python3 proofpress.py ingest <file>`
2. Keep surviving blocks' `[//]: # (ob:xxxxxxxx)` anchors while editing; then
3. Claims JSON, one honest entry per block touched or removed. Do not enumerate

untouched blocks; use `unchanged` only for a deliberate negative claim about
   an important block or scope:
   `[{"block": "<id>", "kind": "added|removed|modified|moved|unchanged", "note": "…"}]`
4. Snapshot with testimony (`--why` required; `--rejected` per dropped

alternative):
   `python3 proofpress.py snapshot <file> --kind agent --author pi --note "…" --claims claims.json --why "…" --rejected "…"`
5. `python3 proofpress.py verify <file>` — report verbatim; never re-snapshot
to force green. A ⚠ is reviewer information.
